g.text: CCI Career Navigator — Approved Persistence Model
Company deletion is restricted while roles exist.
Role-owned junction rows cascade on role deletion;
shared catalog values are restricted from deletion.
Matching Profile input is currently transient React Router state.
Student and MatchingProfile are intentionally not classes/tables here:
the approved Prisma schema has no student identity or saved matching
profile, and the regular Student Profile remains separate.
A role has zero or one minimum experience level.
Each level can be referenced by zero or many roles.
